children: FirstCash entered into a Tenth Amendment to its Amended and Restated Credit Agreement, expanding its unsecured revolving facility to $1.055 billion and extending the maturity to August 27, 2031. The multi-currency facility now permits U.S. Dollar and Pound Sterling borrowings at SONIA or SOFR plus a 2.50% margin, and reduces the unused commitment fee. The amendment also increases the permitted consolidated net leverage ratio to 3.5x EBITDA and provides added covenant flexibility.
: Wells Fargo Bank, as administrative agent, and a syndicate of banks
: Increase liquidity and extend maturities for growth
